name: Northstar marketing site: design-repo
versionFieldNote: allowlistVersion is machine-checked: verify_all.py ALLOWLIST_VERSION fails unless it equals tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json `version`. repositoryVersion is machine-checked too: verify_all.py REPOSITORY_VERSION fails unless it equals the newest CHANGELOG.md entry. pageSpecVersion is a documentation marker (the schema pins pageSpecVersion const '1.0.0' for instances).

brand.name: Northstar
brand.note: Layout and motion clone of a real, live commercial site (superhuman.com) rebuilt under a fictional brand. All copy is independently written placeholder copy; all logos, mockups, avatars and badges are original invented SVG illustrations; fonts are OFL substitutes. See assets/asset-roles.json globalProhibitions.

snapshot.sourceProject: The parent directory of this folder (the Vite site project). Read-only; never edited by this repo.
snapshot.stackNote: Vite + React 18 + Tailwind v3 + react-router-dom 6. verify_all.py SOURCE_DRIFT re-diffs these versions, the route table, each template's source order and ui component coverage against current source.

themeNote: Themes are section contexts (.ctx-light / .ctx-dark), not a page-wide mode; every PageSpec node declares its context.
outOfScope: ComingSoon catch-all routes and the future team / use-case / store / company families (templates/routes.json).

verification.requires: Python 3.9+ with jsonschema (install into a virtualenv).
